entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$3.99 → $2.99 [$2.99 ~ $3.99]）

All Price Information

Application Description

AWTRIX NG is the companion app for pixel clocks running the AWTRIX NG firmware, such as the Ulanzi TC001, the Ulanzi TC002 and other ESP32 LED displays. FIND YOUR CLOCKS The app finds AWTRIX NG clocks in your Wi-Fi. You can also add a clock by its address. SEE AND CONTROL - See what your clock shows, live. - Open the clock's full web interface. - Start and stop scripts and games. AWTRIX HUB BUILT IN Browse scripts and icons made by the community. The Hub shows only what runs on your clock and installs it with one tap. PLAY WITH YOUR PHONE Turn your phone into a gamepad for games on the clock. Two phones can play together. TALK TO YOUR CLOCK Record a short voice message and play it on clocks with a speaker. SHARE TO YOUR CLOCK Send text and pictures from other apps to your clock, or save a picture as an icon. IPHONE NOTIFICATIONS ON THE TC002 The Ulanzi TC002 connects to your iPhone over Bluetooth. It shows your notifications and the music that is playing. You choose which apps appear. PRIVATE BY DESIGN The app talks to your clocks directly in your home network. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Requires a clock running the AWTRIX NG firmware.

entry.title: CURSED ARSENAL: Pixel Survivor
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$2.99 → Free [Free ~ $2.99]）

All Price Information

Price：Free

Application Description

Play chapters 1–10 free. One purchase unlocks all 40 chapters. In the arsenal of the old kingdom of Veyrholm, hungry weapons lay sleeping. They ate the souls of the king and his people, until the Nine Wardens bound them in chains and sealed them away. The game begins on the day the first seal breaks. You are one of those weapons. Attacks are automatic: move with the joystick on the left and use your movement skill with the button on the right. Each enemy you cut down fills your Hunger a little. When Hunger runs out, the weapon falls asleep and the run is over. Spend the Souls you gather in a run to inscribe Shards in the Growth Tree, and you wake up that much stronger in the next run. On each level-up you pick 1 of 3 Curse Cards. If you max out an Attack card while holding its paired Support card, it evolves. Relics dropped by Elites change the rules of the run instead of your stats. - 6 weapons: the Cursed Sword, Axe, Bow, Staff, Twin Blades and Spear. Each has its own basic attack and movement skill (Dash, Leap, Roll, Blink, Gale), and defeating the boss of certain chapters for the first time wakes new weapons. - 8 areas and 40 chapters. There are four difficulties (Novice, Easy, Normal and Hard), and in the full game, clearing Chapter 5 opens Endless Mode. - Four chapters in the first area each have their own look: a candlelit ossuary, a sewer crypt with flowing water, a violet bone sanctuary and an underground chapel lit by moonlight and stained glass. - 8 Wardens, 8 Elite captains and 8 stronger Midbosses each fight with their own attacks. Every attack is telegraphed first. - 19 Attack cards, 23 Support cards, 22 evolutions, 21 Relics and 7 Familiars. - The Growth Tree is an upright sword with four branches and 159 Shards. - The Forge has 5 Part slots, and Honing with Honing Stones never fails and goes up to +20. You get an extra bonus at +5, +10, +15 and +20. - Looks: restyle the 7 parts of each weapon, with 6,434 designs across all 6 weapons. There are 90 Sets you can equip all at once, including Sets from the Joseon, Christmas, Biscuit sticks, Snack bar and Bathhouse editions. They unlock as you clear chapters and defeat enemies, and none of them are sold for money. - After the ending, 10 Curse Tiers open up. There are also per-weapon Records and Today's bounty. - During a run you also run into a fleeing Treasure wraith, a Cursed altar that brings out Elites, and a Mimic pretending to be a chest. - Chapters 1–10 (the ossuary and the monastery, with the Sword and Axe) are free. Buy 'Unlock full game' once to open all 40 chapters, all 6 weapons, the ending and Curse Tiers, keeping your progress. If you already bought the game, everything stays unlocked. No ads and no loot boxes. Your progress is saved on your device. - Available in Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish and German. Also from the same developer: Sasinpae, a card roguelike where you play cards against dokkaebi from Korean folk tales.
